title: Ghomuth
body:
![https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/57495/323/1581111423-117384722.jpeg|medium|right](https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/57495/323/1581111423-117384722.jpeg)

- Bodyguard for hire, but only for other locathah (and is currently protecting the head necromancy cleric of the locathah - Velim).
- She came to Tidecrown because of slavery - she's here to confront those who are involved (both the sahuagin for locathah directly and the Tidecrown people for the kuo-toa).
- Only trusts her fellow locathah, and would risk anything for them. Fears that her civilization will be wiped out.
- Has scheduled sparring session with Cordelia - they know each other from before they both got to the base, and are from the same general area (Dark Sea).

### Motivation and Goals

 - [x] Kill a Shark. ✅ 2026-02-16
 - [ ]  Learn a weapon proficiency
 - 10 weeks to learn to use a Maul - needs 100 gp per week.
 - [ ]  Learn a language.
 - 10 weeks to learn Elvish.
 - [ ]  Kill big fish (1 level for every 3 creatures larger then Large).
 - 1: Aalpamac
